{"id":1536,"tenderTitle":"I-HAB  External AIT activities (EXA)","tenderNumber":"21.THIT.011","tenderDescription":"The Cislunar Gateway International Habitat (I-HAB) is ESAs contribution of an infrastructure element supporting the Gateway with full crew habitability and utilization requirements from 2025. The Cislunar Gateway is a multi-element infrastructure designed to support both robotic and human exploration of cis-lunar space and act as a basecamp for sustained lunar exploration. The Lunar Gateway is smaller than the ISS and will require less launches for its assembly. It is intended to be occupied by a crew of up to four astronauts for periods ranging from two weeks to two months, but otherwise operates as a robotic spacecraft.
The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the contractor for I-HAB External AIT activities (EXA) in accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.
The I-HAB External AIT activities (EXA) is part of the support equipment to integrate and test the I-HAB Gateway module.

-	AIT Mechanical operator
-	AIT Fluidic/Alignment operator
-	AIT EGSE expert operator
-	AIT Functional Operator
-	AIT QA operator

-	Integration and test activities documentation examination
-	Documentation preparation and configuration control of hardware and tooling
-	Operative AIT tasks execution
-	Test conduction and participation
-	Test set-up preparation
-	Handling of the flight hardware and GSE 
-	Work could be performed in shift and in holidays time
